# bosk Provider

Provides access to a bosk maintenance endpoint. This API exposes full read and write access to the bosk state tree, so use credentials with the smallest appropriate privileges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "bosk" {
  endpoint = "https://app.example.com/bosk/state"

  # Credentials can also be supplied through BOSK_TOKEN,
  # BOSK_USERNAME, and BOSK_PASSWORD.
  # token = "example-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust in addition to the system roots. May also be set with the `BOSK_CA_CERT` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the bosk maintenance endpoints, for example `https://app.example.com/bosk/state`. May also be set with the `BOSK_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional HTTP headers to send with every request.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. This is insecure and should only be used for local development. May also be set with the `BOSK_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for HTTP Basic authentication. May also be set with the `BOSK_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `request_timeout` (String) Timeout for each HTTP request, as a duration string such as `10s`. Defaults to `10s`. May also be set with the `BOSK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token sent in the `Authorization` header. May also be set with the `BOSK_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for HTTP Basic authentication. May also be set with the `BOSK_USERNAME` environment variable.
